description.zh_CN: 把控制台里的节点状态变成规范的 REST API：节点列表、实时状态、历史负载、Ping 记录一站查全，供机器人插件、脚本与自建面板调用。
description.en: Expose console-visible server metrics as a clean REST API for bots, scripts and custom dashboards.

help.zh_CN: 多个令牌用逗号分隔。请求带上令牌（Authorization: Bearer / ?token=）即可查看隐藏节点与完整信息；留空时 API 以访客视角工作。
help.en: Comma-separated tokens. Requests with a token see hidden nodes and full details; without tokens the API works in guest view.

help.zh_CN: 开启后响应携带 Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *，网页端可以直接调用。
help.en: Adds Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * so browser apps can call the API directly.
